platform: macOS Apple Silicon; Intel Managed storage and other OSes not validated

legend.V: Verified specific assertion with named native evidence; not blanket coverage
legend.P: Partial or indirect, shared infrastructure, synthetic state, or narrower producer coverage
legend.N: Not applicable to the explicitly stated resource; not a substitute for testing related caches

AT.title: Atlas odd-width pixels, cache hits, replay, eviction and changed-data reinsertion

TX.title: Native/Parley text atlas captures; no glyph pixel oracle
TX.run: capture-only; not counted as glyph correctness

SH.title: Native/custom shapes, paths, opacity, clipping and replay pixel comparisons

SC.title: Solid/gradient/mesh cache: pending sharing, completed reuse, eviction, queue isolation and generation errors

WO.title: Owned objc2 texture/command transfer, identity, pending state, submission and queue rejection

WS.title: Wide SDR float pixels, ordering, coverage, rejected contracts, mode switches and renderer isolation

CV.title: CoreVideo snapshot ownership through pending sampling and completion (BGRA + four NV12 variants)

CS.title: Native Surface retains cache after renderer destruction; completion releases cache owner

VP.title: Custom video exact bars/range/matrix, masks, opacity and import reuse

SP.title: Independent native PaintSurface BGRA and colored full-range NV12 pixels, clipping, resize and replay

LC.title: Renderer/window churn, shader sharing, nonblocking atlas/video/Surface retirement, RSS and reference counts

GP.title: Independent CPU reference for wide compositing, alpha, order, masks, overlays and resize

GI.title: Instanced P3 versus typed producer pixels, alpha, replay, resize and default-mode rejection

WG.title: Portable WGSL parameter/source cache semantics and pixel checks

FR.title: Batch validation, queue/device/extent rejection and state rechecks; not actual GPU faults

IM.title: GPUI atlas versus dedicated MediaImage captures and upload-count checks

OW.title: 17 native resource variants: unsubmitted sampling abandonment, gated submission/completion after renderer destruction, CPU preparation rejection and mixed native window teardown
OW.run: just regression-tests / lifecycle / worker/lifecycle/ownership/report.json (51 frame cases + 3 mixed-window cases)

paths.migration: objc2 atlas; temporary legacy binding bridge
paths.visual: Exact monochrome/BGRA byte and pixel assertions
paths.limits: Unsubmitted sampling abandonment releases the actual host pool; completion pixels prove atlas textures survive renderer destruction. Atlas upload itself already occurred during fixture preparation. Synthetic masks do not establish glyph raster correctness; Intel Managed storage remains untested.

paths.migration: Atlas migrated; text shaping/rasterization and compositor not fully migrated
paths.limits: Mixed native windows exercise text/emoji with unpainted, completed and GPU-pending teardown. Shared native pool/atlas ownership is covered indirectly; no isolated glyph-resource weak observer or glyph pixel goldens, fractional coverage, font/size changes.

paths.migration: Compositor remains metal-rs; migrated atlas bindings can participate in glyph masks
paths.limits: Native quad and filled path survive renderer destruction with exact interior pixels. Mixed windows include rounded/bordered shapes. CPU preparation rejection is a later custom producer failure, not shape allocation or GPU-error injection; mask cancellation and resize remain separate.

paths.path: Atlas sprites and dedicated MediaImage textures
paths.migration: Atlas migrated; dedicated uploads/compositor remain legacy Metal
paths.visual: Atlas exact pixels; dedicated image capture/upload checks
paths.limits: Atlas and uploaded dedicated MediaImage have completion pixel oracles and tracked producer release after abandonment/completion/window teardown. Dedicated-image cache eviction, replacement under pressure and cross-renderer reuse remain incomplete.

paths.path: Custom solid, gradient and mesh paints
paths.migration: Producers remain metal-rs; queue retention uses objc2
paths.limits: Solid, gradient, mesh and WGSL each verify tracked producer/host-pool retention while sampling is pending and release after abandonment/completion. Mixed-window teardown covers all. CPU preparation rejection is tested; actual GPU-error cleanup is not.

paths.path: Portable WGSL and instanced shader programs
paths.migration: Compiler/pipelines/compositor remain legacy; shared queue bridge is a migrated dependency
paths.limits: WGSL paint and instanced shader verify final-owner release after abandonment/completion plus pixels after renderer destruction; native mixed windows include both. Program/pipeline eviction and true cross-queue program reuse remain gaps. No GPU fault injected.

paths.migration: WideColor allocation/encoding migrated to objc2; host compositor still legacy
paths.visual: CPU reference, native float-P3 assertions and instanced parity
paths.limits: WideColor has no producer LRU (N); scratch/pipeline caches are separate. Pending renderer destruction, unsubmitted sampling abandonment and mixed-window teardown now have direct probes. GPU errors and interrupted producer replacement remain untested; physical display fidelity unverified.

paths.migration: Import device/texture bridge migrated; compositing remains legacy
paths.limits: BGRA and all four NV12 range/matrix variants verify pending producer retention and final-owner release after sampling abandonment/completion and mixed-window teardown. Failed import/allocation and same snapshot across two queues remain gaps. Producer preparation may have submitted work before host sampling abandonment.

paths.migration: Texture bridge migrated; cache ownership fix committed
paths.visual: Independent Surface pixels; cache ownership after renderer drop
paths.limits: BGRA/full-range NV12 verify host/cache/buffer release after unsubmitted sampling abandonment, completion and CPU preparation rejection, plus mixed-window teardown. Import failure and cross-queue reuse remain gaps; native Surface does not gain custom-video BT.709/video-range support.

release_gates.requirement: 51 frame probes cover 17 resource variants across host sampling abandonment, gated completion after renderer destruction and CPU preparation rejection. Abandoned sampling remains NotEnqueued; actual pool/producer/cache/buffer owners release. Producer preparation/upload may already have submitted work. Text is covered through mixed-window/shared-atlas teardown, not isolated glyph cancellation.

Every native resource variant rejects a later CPU producer preparation and checks final-owner release. Actual GPU command Error, allocation and native import failure cleanup remain unverified; no intentional GPU fault is injected.

Three mixed-window cases close before painting, after completion and while GPU work is gated. Text, shapes, atlas/dedicated images, WGSL/instanced shaders, wide color, all custom video variants and native Surfaces are included. Test-support submission uses the window renderer with an offscreen target; drawable presentation itself is not asserted.
Run shader-program, video snapshot and Surface reuse across distinct queues and teardown; strengthen glyph/dedicated-image oracles.
Published registry consumer must build without patches, then repeat against the eventual candidate release. Current 534cdf4 migration/fix is not represented by published 1.0.0.
Prove metal/objc/block/cocoa are absent from selected macOS graph when full migration claims their removal.
Run on Intel Managed storage and appropriate display configurations; timing/RSS baselines must be hardware/profile matched.
CI currently pins 9e6a732110a1fb1cd6b7ff12bf306d95ceb1fb12; align it with the reviewed fix revision 534cdf465615be127480b5add62b2b8df89915dd before relying on CI evidence.
Native benchmark evidence is local/manual. Existing CI uses mocked app tests and manual dispatch; add native hardware execution with retained reports before making it a release gate.

assessment_scope: Assessed commit plus uncommitted test-support hooks in gpui-apple metal_renderer.rs, gpui platform.rs/window.rs, and gpui-macos window.rs. Production rendering behavior is unchanged; native ownership probes require these hooks.
